crossRefs.note: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.
I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked…
The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.
For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

translations.web: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.
translations.bsb: The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked will not inhabit the land.
translations.kjv: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
translations.asv: The righteous shall never be removed; But the wicked shall not dwell in the land.
